age.evidence: Experiments were performed on adult (~11 weeks old) C57BL/6J male mice.

sex.evidence: Experiments were performed on adult (~11 weeks old) C57BL/6J male mice.

psychedelic: Psilocybin (chemically synthesized, PSIL); Psychedelic mushroom extract (PME, Psilocybe cubensis)

dosing.evidence: PSIL and PME were dissolved in 0.9% NaCl. Whether administered PSIL or PME, mice received psilocybin at a dose of 4.4 mg/kg intraperitoneally (i.p.).

dosing.doses_raw: PME (adjusted to a PSIL dose of 4.4 mg/kg); 10.15mg of PME is needed per 30 g mouse
dosing.evidence: For PME the dose was based on the following calculation... 76.92 × 0.132 mg = 10.15mg of PME is needed per 30 g mouse. The 4.4 mg/kg value is the psilocybin-equivalent dose; the extract mass dose is approximately 338 mg/kg.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed under standardized conditions (cage density not stated); mice were 'randomly extracting them from the holding cages'.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were housed under standardized conditions with a 12-h light/dark cycle (direction/testing phase not stated)

assays.assay_description: HTR recorded for 20 min with a magnetometer apparatus. Ear-attached neodymium magnets were used, and mice were placed in the apparatus immediately after i.p. vehicle, PSIL or PME (4.4 mg/kg psilocybin). Outcomes were the time course in 2-min bins, total HTR and peak HTR.

application_type.evidence: mice received psilocybin at a dose of 4.4 mg/kg intraperitoneally (i.p.)

setup_habituation.evidence: After a 5-7-day recovery period, the ear-tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus ... immediately after injection (no apparatus habituation described)

setup_restrain.evidence: the ear-tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus ... immediately after injection; no restraint described

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the magnetometer apparatus during the 20-min recording (home cage: free access to food and water)

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the magnetometer apparatus during the 20-min recording (home cage: free access to food and water)

time_to_assay.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus ... immediately after injection of vehicle, PSIL, or PME

sample_size.evidence: Fig. 1 legend: n = 10-16. The total of 40 is derived from Treatment F [2, 37], and PSIL vs PME F [1, 28] implies 30 drug-treated mice.

outcomes.summary: PSIL and PME (both 4.4 mg/kg psilocybin) strongly increased HTR compared to vehicle over 20 min, with a peak at 4 min post-injection. There was no difference between PSIL and PME in time course, total HTR or peak HTR.
outcomes.statistics: Vehicle vs PSIL/PME: Time × Treatment F [18, 333] = 10.86 p < 0.0001, Treatment F [2, 37] = 52.18 p < 0.0001; PSIL vs PME: Time × Treatment F [9, 252] = 1.162 p = 0.3197, Treatment F [1, 28] = 0.04689 p = 0.8301; Total HTR: Vehicle vs PSIL/PME p < 0.0001, PSIL vs PME p = 0.9419; Peak HTR: Vehicle vs PSIL/PME p < 0.0001, PSIL vs PME p = 0.8662 (Šídák)
outcomes.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins over 20 min) showed a strong increase of HTR (Fig. 1a) compared to vehicle ... and no difference was observed between PSIL and PME

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins over 20 min) ... Total and peak PSIL/PME-induced HTR during the 20 min measuring period were compiled

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: HTR over time (2 min time bins over 20 min) ... Both treatments induced a peak effect at 4 min post injection.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions, sequences or bout structure.

B4_ethological.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) is excluded as ethological per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: A custom MATLAB script was used to record the processed signal, which was presented as graphs showing the change in current as peaks (mAh). This is magnetometer peak detection, not pose estimation or an ML behaviour classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only ANOVAs were applied to the HTR data.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in the magnetometer apparatus.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described in the magnetometer apparatus.

E6_spatial.evidence: placed inside a magnetometer apparatus (single chamber)

E7_social_context.evidence: Ear-tagged animals were placed inside a magnetometer apparatus individually; recording was from the individual's ear magnets.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) was measured over 20 min

D2_session_duration.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) was measured over 20 min

D5_followup.evidence: HTR was recorded only immediately after injection.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (HTR) is retained. Western blots, metabolomics and plasma psilocin are non-behavioural and excluded. All candidates agreed on this.
B1 set to score 1 ('2-3'). Three measures are reported (binned time course, total HTR, peak HTR). This overrides deepseek's '4-6' and gemma's inconsistent score 2 with value '2-3'.
D2 set to score 1 for the 20-min session (15–60 min bin). Gemma's score of 0 contradicts the rubric cutoff.
day_night_flipped is not_reported because the paper gives only a bare '12-h light/dark cycle' with no direction stated (modal answer, per rubric). Deepseek's 'no' was not adopted.
setup_restrain is 'no' (deepseek/gemma). Mice were placed in the magnetometer apparatus with no restraint described.
n_total = 40 is inferred from the ANOVA degrees of freedom (Treatment F[2,37]; PSIL vs PME F[1,28] implies vehicle n=10). n_per_group_min = 10 is from the Fig. 1 legend, n = 10-16.
PME dose is recorded as the 4.4 mg/kg psilocybin-equivalent (modal). The evidence field notes the extract mass dose of about 338 mg/kg (10.15 mg per 30 g mouse).
